blocks.text: Nadine Lustre has released her latest single, “10YRS,” which reflects on “all versions” of herself throughout her 20s. The 32-year-old actress-singer spoke about her new music through a series of posts on her Instagram page. “This song is my way of honoring all the versions of me that existed through my 20s. Not for having it all figured out, but for becoming in their own time,” she said. “May this song find a place in you, wherever you are in your own becoming.” View this post on Instagram A post shared by Nadine Lustre (@nadine) Lustre also opened up about the […]...
